what: A counterexample to the shifted Lonely Runner Conjecture for n = 79 runners: the open arcs {t : ||v_i t + s_i|| < 1/80} of these 79 runners cover the circle R/Z, so at every time some runner is closer than 1/(n+1) = 1/80 to the origin.
